name: 50662 · Oelwein, IA
findings: ZIP 50662 (Oelwein) has 42 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (19%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 7 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 50662 (Oelwein) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 50662 (Oelwein) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 56% of the typical level).

observations.text: 7 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
